description: An application submitted under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment to planning permission DC/24/136123, dated 17 October 2024, to amend the approved development description.Original Description:'Demolition of the existing plumbers merchants and the construction of a four-storey building with commercial use on the ground floor and 6 self-contained flats on the upper floors and 3 x three-storey dwellinghouses, together with associated landscaping, car parking, refuse and cycle storage at 1-1A Davenport Road SE6'Proposed Amended Description:'Demolition of the existing plumbers merchants and the construction of a four-storey building with commercial use on the ground floor and 6 self-contained flats on the upper floors and 3 dwellinghouses, together with associated landscaping, car parking, refuse and cycle storage at 1-1A Davenport Road SE6'
